stance: Growth: Q3 advance GDP printed 3.4% SAAR, up from 2.2% in Q2. Spending data is strong (September retail sales +0.77% m/m; core capex orders +0.46%). September trade deficit was little changed at -105.0bn (-105.7bn in August). October ISM manufacturing is unconfirmed (one publisher): PMI 55.5, new orders 55.5, employment 52.4, prices paid 75.2, so forward orders stay in expansion. Watch ISM confirmation, control group, core capex, later GDP estimates.
